source: BK3 printed pp.36-37 = book2-3-4.pdf PDF pp.42-43; ER-07 replaces the diagram without changing the program list; Step 7 speculative derivation from topology
note: Speculative (Step 7): every expect is derived by hand from the four wires and the p.36-37 rule (A X B = C, pushbutton DOWN = 1, light ON = 1). Only light 3 for both pushbuttons down is printed as an observable (A/III-3STMT); the page also prints the full 1 X 1 / 0 X 1 / 1 X 0 / 0 X 0 table, which this fixture checks on the circuit, including the 1 X 0 case reached by releasing pushbutton 2 from the lit state (the printed fixture covers pushbutton 1 alone from rest). Topology: a single series path 1+ -> 1Y-1X -> 2Y-2X -> 3A-3B -> 3-; the N.C. contacts 1Z and 2Z are unwired, no relay, switch or motor is used, and nothing loops back, so each input set has one settled state. The 500 ms advance before each expect lets the lamp finish its thermal transient; the page states no timing.
